description: A clipper and waveshaper for two signals, with nine curves to choose between

params.text: Picks the curve: Soft, Hard, Sin, OD, Exp, Sqr, Abs, AAH or AAS, the last two being versions of the hard and soft clips with their aliasing smoothed
Sets how hard the signal is driven into the curve, 0 to 10
Attenuates the voltage at the Drv jack before it is added to the Drv knob, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The first signal to be clipped, one per channel
The second signal to be clipped, one per channel; with nothing patched here the first signal is sent to both outputs
Modulates the drive, scaled by the Drive CV knob

outputs.text: The first signal after the curve
The second signal after the curve, or a copy of the first while In2 is empty

notes: the curve and the drive are shared, so both signals are shaped the same way

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the In1 jack.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
